_about: Shops (Shop, ShopMenu, ShopScreen; README.md, Shops). Per shop: name, map (its inside, data/maps), open [first hour, closing hour) and days_off (mon..sun): outside those the door and the counter only say closed_message (%s = the shop name, then the hours and the days off). keeper: the villager who stands at the counter ("" = nobody; the counter works without one); with a keeper the shop also sells only while their day plan has them on the shop's map, and talking to them at the map's keeper spot opens it. stock: what it sells, per season plus "any" (every season) and "supplies" (every season, listed first), each {item, price?, name?, to?, full?}: without a price the item's own one is used (seed_price in crops.json for seeds:<crop>, price in foods.json for food:<id>). to says where a purchase goes: "rucksack" (default), "animal" (animal:<kind>, Game.add_animal, refused with full when its home has no room) "feed" (portions into the coop's feed sack) or "fodder" (bundles into the barn's loft); animal:<kind>:young is a calf / lamb (grows up in the barn). rucksack: bigger rucksacks for sale, each level {slots (the bag's new size), price}, bought once each in order. kitchen_tools: cooking tools for sale once the house extension needs is built, each bought once (names and prices in data/recipes.json tools; Game.kitchen_tools, saved), listed in the buy tab after the rucksack. builds: house extensions the builder (a villager) makes, per id {name, about, price, days, chest_slots?}; done is the morning message (%s = its name); away is what the builder's own counter says while they are out building (Game.BUILD_FLAG, from the morning after the order; their day plan puts them on the farm); plan is that day plan's name: a day of the job they spend on another plan (a storm keeps Hachiro at the forge, his birthday) doesn't count, the job is due a day later (Game house_job late), and the note says away_late (%s = its name, then the new due date) and the build tab late (%s = the due date); one at a time, paid when ordered, finished overnight on the ready day; the map changes come from the "extensions" of that map's file (data/maps/house.json). buys: what it buys from the farmer, kind -> percent of the item's value (crop = its sell price, dish = a food's sell in foods.json (the kitchen's dishes; not foods with shop true, which the stand sells), food = its price (other foods); stone, ore and gem = the kinds of mine finds, their sell in data/mine.json). upgrades: tools it improves, per target level {price, days, items?} (items: id -> how many, taken from the rucksack when the tool is handed in, e.g. ores from the mine) (tool_levels: other levels for one tool, e.g. the rod, whose levels are in data/fish.json); the tool is handed in, comes back that many days later (collect it while the shop is open). Names, prices and hours are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Shops.

clinic._note: Dr. Yae's Hinata Clinic (data/maps/clinic.json): open every day, since people fall ill on Sundays too; it sells only the herb tonic, the one food that takes a big bite out of fatigue. 400 G is ours: more than amazake (stamina) and mugwort tea (half swing fatigue), so it is a remedy, not a snack; about the price of a collapse's fee plus a lost morning's work.
